caption: The drawing features a single wooden cabinet depicted against a plain, light beige background. The cabinet is rectangular in shape and stands on four short, rounded, and slightly tapered legs. It has two front doors, each divided into three rectangular panels, with a muted greenish-brown color. The outer frame and the edges of the doors are a slightly darker brown, giving definition to the structure. The top of the cabinet features a broad, flat cornice that overhangs the main body. The side of the cabinet is visible, displaying similar paneling as seen on the front. There is a small, ornate keyhole on the right door indicating a lock mechanism. The overall composition is centered, with no other objects present in the drawing, and the color scheme consists mainly of earthy brown and greenish tones.
title: Cabinet
